subject: FinRoute: Dedicated GPU Capacity — architecture review & timing
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@finroute.com>, Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@finroute.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FinRoute: Dedicated GPU Capacity — architecture review & timing

Hi Alice / Miguel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a focused architecture review that covers: pool sizing, autoscale behavior under mixed workloads, and tenant isolation strategies for your compliance requirements. Goal: give your infra team enough detail to sign off on the Dedicated deployment proposal.

Suggested agenda (attached) and two 90-min slot options:
- Option A: Thu 2026-10-14 10:00–11:30 PT
- Option B: Fri 2026-10-15 14:00–15:30 PT

If neither works, tell us a preferred day/time and we'll adapt. We'll bring the serving runtime lead and the capacity planner (cc'd).

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-capacity-agenda.pdf (agenda + pre-read), finroute-current-loads.xlsx (you shared this during the demo)

Thanks,
Olga
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
--

From: Alice Park <alice.park@finroute.com>

Date: 2026-10-08T08:37:00-04:00
Subject: Re: FinRoute: Dedicated GPU Capacity — architecture review & timing

Hi Olga — thanks, that looks good. Either slot should work for the biz team, but I want Miguel and our infra folks in the session to confirm the network/isolation items. Miguel, can you confirm availability?

Also quick ask: could you include an appendix that maps Redwood's isolation modes to our SOC2 requirements (encryption at rest, VPC peering constraints, audit logs)? If you can attach a short matrix, that would help our security reviewers.

Best,
Alice
Director, Engineering
FinRoute Solutions
From: Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@finroute.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@finroute.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: FinRoute: Dedicated GPU Capacity — architecture review & timing

On Fri, Oct 9, 2026 at 10:05 AM Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@finroute.com> wrote:

> Hi team — I can do the Fri slot (Option B) but not Thu. Prefer Fri 14:00 PT.
> We'll also invite two infra engineers (Natasha and Ben) from our side.

A couple of prep items from our side: can you share the following before the session?
- Example autoscale policy you recommend for mixed batch/interactive workloads
- A short failure-mode slide for isolation breach scenarios and failover controls
- Any runbook snippets for token/KV cache warmup you plan to demo

If you can drop those into the Drive folder (link below) by EOD Thursday our infra team will skim them ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Miguel
Principal Infra Engineer
FinRoute Solutions
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@finroute.com>, Alice Park <alice.park@finroute.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: FinRoute architecture review — Fri 2026-10-15 14:00 PT (90 min)

Thanks Miguel — Fri 2026-10-15 14:00–15:30 PT is now booked. Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finroute-architecture-review-20261009

Quick notes / prep we added to the Drive folder:
- redwood-dedicated-capacity-agenda.pdf (finalized agenda; includes a 10-min security appendix mapping to common SOC2 controls)
- autoscale-policy-examples.pdf (three policies tuned for mixed workloads)
- failure-modes-and-fallbacks.pdf (isolation breach scenarios + remediation steps)
- runbook-snippets.txt (KV cache warmup, prefix caching tips)

We will open the meeting with a 15-min overview, then deep-dive the pool sizing model (30–35 min), then autoscale behaviour (25 min), and wrap with isolation/Q&A. Please add any specific questions to the Drive doc or reply all.

Dial-in and guest access: Zoom link in calendar invite; Natasha and Ben from FinRoute should be able to join as guests. If you need a VPC/network diagram added, ping me and Olga will pull one together.

See you Friday — Aditya
Senior Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference
